title: finding(types, docs): exported `*FieldMetadata` types declare members `FieldSchema` refuses (`pattern_message`, `min_date`, `starting_number`, …), docs teach them, and no member-level pin covers the family
body:
Ruled: 6137052265 · letter A (dueLike stays on the authoring face; the fork of 6135661503 resolved) · 2026-10-13T02:44Z
Ruled: 6135661503 · letter A · 2026-10-13T00:55Z
Filing class: **① product defect**, a `finding` of class (b), the family close-out card for "objectui field metadata declares a key the spec's `FieldSchema` refuses". Reach: named producers, the field docs pages below, which teach authors and agents spellings the strict door refuses.

- **Who acts:** triage grades and routes. The declarations are in `packages/types/src/field-types.ts`, and the pages are in `content/docs/fields/`.
- **Why a family card:** this is the family's third single-key card in one day (objectui#12156 for the `max_*` keys, objectui#12157 for three `lookup` legs, objectui#12213 for `help`). Each one retired its keys and left the rest of the family standing. The rule for this case is one card that covers every position, with an enumeration pin, not another single-key card.
- **Dedupe:** two objectui issue searches, closed included. "FieldMetadata types declare members FieldSchema refuses census enumeration pin snake_case field metadata" returned 12 hits. "pattern_message starting_number auto_number field docs keys spec refuses text auto-number object field page" returned 1. None is open, and none covers the types member by member. The nearest are objectui#5761 (closed: a key-level parity guard for field DESIGNER payloads), objectui#6138 (closed: the docs pages declared their own interfaces) and objectui#4687 (closed: two `VectorFieldMetadata` keys).
- **Found by:** the os-dev of objectui#12213 (PR objectui#12236, report `6123163546`, out-of-scope finding 1). Widened and filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat (objectui#10217), session `session_0149MdowTfyuWZuSSESLUYnE`.

## The reading (objectui `main` after objectui#12157)

- **The dev's measurement**, on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0: `FieldSchema.safeParse` refuses `pattern` and `pattern_message` on a text field, `starting_number`, and `schema` on an object field, each with `unrecognized_keys`. The type values `auto_number` and `object` give `invalid_value` at `type`; the spec spells the first `autonumber`. Control: a text literal with `label`, `maxLength` and `inlineHelpText` is accepted.
- **This seat's census** of snake_case members on the exported field metadata interfaces in `field-types.ts`: `mobile_fullscreen`, `visible_on`, `pattern_message`, `min_date` / `max_date` (two interfaces), `default_zoom`, `starting_number`, plus `reference_field` and `avatar_field`. Triage measured those last two out of scope on objectui#12157: no `FieldSchema` twin, or a ruled shape. The `never`-typed members (`min_rows`, `allow_add` and the rest, each mapped to its camelCase key in the same file) are excluded too; they are already refused by type. A census for name only: neither the readers nor the spec twins were measured.
- **The docs:** `text.mdx` teaches `pattern` / `pattern_message`, `auto-number.mdx` teaches `starting_number` and `type: 'auto_number'`, and `object.mdx` teaches `schema` and `type: 'object'`. The dev read this.

## What the close-out owes (triage decides)

One measured census of every member of every exported field metadata interface against `FieldSchema`. Each row gets one verdict: the spec's spelling by reference, retired (no reader, no twin), or a runtime-only hand-off typed on a package-local type (objectui `AGENTS.md` #0.1). Then one enumeration pin that fails on a new member with no verdict. The docs pages follow the verdicts.

Dedupe words: FieldMetadata member FieldSchema refuses · pattern_message starting_number default_zoom · auto_number type value spec autonumber · field docs teach refused keys
